response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_orders FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.gender), gender_average AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders) AS avg_invoiced_orders FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(gc.invoiced_orders) AS average_figure, AVG(gc.invoiced_orders - ga.avg_invoiced_orders) AS average_excess FROM gender_counts gc CROSS JOIN gender_average ga WHERE gc.invoiced_orders > ga.avg_invoiced_orders;
